# Evidence you can use.

Build the habits to analyse clinical data, judge research fairly, and turn uncertain evidence into thoughtful decisions.

<div class="hero-actions">
  <a href="S1_T01_DescribingData/index.html">Start with Topic 1</a>
  <a class="secondary" href="course-guide.html">How the course works</a>
</div>

## One course, two connected questions

Semester 1 develops a practical statistical language for analysing clinical data. Semester 2 uses that language to ask whether evidence is trustworthy, meaningful, and applicable.

::: {.semester-heading}
## Semester 1
<span>How do we analyse data?</span>
:::

<div class="topic-grid">
<a class="topic-card" href="S1_T01_DescribingData/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 01</span><span class="topic-title">Describing data</span><span class="topic-description">Variables, summaries, visualisation, distributions, and the foundations of R.</span></a>
<a class="topic-card" href="S1_T02_SignalVsNoise/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 02</span><span class="topic-title">Signal vs the noise</span><span class="topic-description">Samples, uncertainty, p-values, confidence intervals, errors, and power.</span></a>
<a class="topic-card" href="S1_T03_ComparingGroups/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 03</span><span class="topic-title">Comparing groups</span><span class="topic-description">Two groups, multiple groups, categorical outcomes, and clinical importance.</span></a>
<a class="topic-card" href="S1_T04_CorrelationCausation/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 04</span><span class="topic-title">Correlation and causation</span><span class="topic-description">Scatterplots, correlation, confounding, and the beginnings of causal thinking.</span></a>
<a class="topic-card" href="S1_T05_MeasureRisk/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 05</span><span class="topic-title">Measuring risk</span><span class="topic-description">Absolute risk, risk difference, relative risk, odds, NNT, and clear communication.</span></a>

<a class="topic-card placeholder" href="S1_T08_ClinicalDecisionMaking/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 08</span><span class="topic-title">Clinical decision making</span><span class="topic-description">Thresholds, trade-offs, uncertainty, and moving from evidence to action.</span></a>

:::

<div class="topic-grid">
<a class="topic-card placeholder" href="S2_T09_AskingClinicalQuestions/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 09</span><span class="topic-title">Asking clinical questions</span><span class="topic-description">Turn clinical uncertainty into focused questions using PICO and meaningful outcomes.</span></a>

<a class="topic-card placeholder" href="S2_T13_BeingMisled/index.html"><span class="number">TOPIC 13</span><span class="topic-title">Are we being misled?</span><span class="topic-description">Selective reporting, outcome bias, cognitive bias, and persuasive presentation.</span></a>

## The weekly rhythm

::: {.fourfold}
<div><strong>Expert case study</strong>A modern clinical problem grounds the week in a real decision.</div>
<div><strong>Theory</strong>Short explanations build a consistent conceptual foundation.</div>
<div><strong>Code-along</strong>Follow an analysis from question to clinically meaningful interpretation.</div>
<div><strong>Tutorial-lab</strong>Adapt the workflow, make a decision, and add to your lab book.</div>
:::
